input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, which is the preferred position. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer is free to engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC or minimum-volume commitment, and clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-style restraint (12.4, Vendor not to market a service competing with Customer's analytics products) runs in our favour and is therefore not flagged. No searches surfaced "sole and exclusive provider", "all requirements", or third-party procurement restrictions binding Customer.
